items.name: cadence-base
items.title: Cadence base
items.description: Pins a Cadence project to Base UI, lucide icons, and the neutral shadcn theme.

items.name: cadence-motion
items.title: Motion presets
items.description: Durations, easings, springs, and recipe resolution shared by every Cadence component.

items.name: cadence-utils
items.title: Utilities
items.description: The cn() helper every Cadence component uses to merge Tailwind classes.

items.name: cadence-provider
items.title: Provider
items.description: Optional provider that wires prefers-reduced-motion, motion intensity, and shared defaults into one MotionConfig.

items.name: cadence-theme
items.title: Cadence theme
items.description: Motion CSS variables and intensity rules layered on top of the shadcn theme.

items.name: fade-in
items.title: Fade in
items.description: Reveal content on scroll with a short rise and a reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: Reveal a heading or paragraph word by word, with a single accessible sentence.

items.name: number-flow
items.title: Number flow
items.description: A number that rolls from its previous value to the next, with a static accessible value.

items.name: morph-button
items.title: Morph button
items.description: A button whose label and width morph between idle, loading, success, and error.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated tabs
items.description: Tabs with a shared-element indicator and an animated panel swap.

items.name: motion-accordion
items.title: Motion accordion
items.description: An accordion whose panels spring open and closed, with a rotating chevron.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll progress
items.description: A reading-progress bar that follows the page scroll on a spring.

items.name: motion-dialog
items.title: Motion dialog
items.description: A Base UI dialog whose panel rises and settles on a spring, interruptible mid-exit.
